what_this_is: Every target the unattended worker has scored and every one it declined with the reason attached. One entry per protein, held-out sets built so no two compounds share an ECFP4 Tanimoto cluster at 0.6.

headline.why_this_metric: Spearman depends on how far apart the true affinities are, so a set whose compounds bind similarly scores low however good the predictions are. Median fold error is less sensitive to that, though not free of it: see error-sources.json. Every target's affinity range is given below so an individual result can be judged.

stability_as_the_corpus_grew: 4.5 fold at 28 targets, 4.5 at 41, 4.4 at 98. The estimate moved 0.1 fold while the sample tripled.
